prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1072; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed file, and we ask that all further communication regarding this matter be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact the client directly about the claim, the accident, or any settlement discussions.

Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is currently receiving medical treatment. We are gathering records and will provide documentation of medical expenses, lost income, and other damages as they are compiled.

To permit a proper evaluation of this claim, please disclose in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage known to you.

We further request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or telematics records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or total-loss appraisal documentation. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter.
